texts: In hypoplastic left heart syndrome the systemic circulation depends on the ductus arteriosus, so prostaglandin is started at once and survival depends on keeping the duct open: statements A and C are true.
Ventilation keeps the PaCO2 around 40 mmHg, avoiding hyperventilation, which lowers pulmonary resistance and steals flow from the body: statement B is true.
Transplantation for this lesion uses the donor aortic arch to rebuild the small recipient arch: statement D is true.
The Norwood reconstruction makes the pulmonary artery the main outlet of the single functional ventricle: statement E is true.
So all five statements are true: A, B, C, D and E.
